data.description: Kraken 是一款基于 W3C 标准的高性能渲染引擎。Kraken 底层基于 Flutter 进行渲染，通过其自绘渲染的特性，保证多端一致性。上层基于 W3C 标准实现，拥有非常庞大的前端开发者生态。
data.label: Kraken

data.description: Kraken is a high-performance rendering engine based on W3C standards. Kraken's underlying rendering is based on Flutter, ensuring multi-end consistency through its self-drawing rendering features. The upper layer is implemented based on W3C standards, with a vast front-end developer ecosystem.
data.label: Kraken
